comparison.objective: Press a spring-loaded picture-frame back flush while rotating four retaining clips over it.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand suppresses spring-back while the other turns clips, with hand swapping; there are no concentric tools or torque-coupled adjustable parts.
comparison.success_condition: All clips turned over the flush back, hands released, and arms returned.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual holding while turning is generic; this task tests retaining a depressed panel with turn buttons, not locking a calibrated stop.
